description: Write hreflang tags for the language versions of one page: give each version's language code ("en", "en-GB", "pt-BR") and full address, plus an x-default. Answers the link tags, the same set as sitemap entries, the codes as written and notes on what was wrong (en-UK, a country without a language, a relative address, a missing x-default). Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.

pages.description: One entry per language version of the same page.

lang.description: The language, optionally with a region: "en", "en-GB", "pt-BR".

xDefault.description: The page for visitors whose language isn't listed.

name: generate_hreflang_tags
title: Write hreflang tags
